title: Morphisms between completions are the limit of sections of the sheaf Hom modulo powers of the ideal
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme and $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals, with the category $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$, the notation $\mathcal I^n\mathcal M$ and the completion functor $\mathcal M\mapsto\mathcal M^\wedge=(\mathcal M/\mathcal I^n\mathcal M)_{n\ge1}$ of [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ be coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], $\mathcal H=\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)$ the sheaf Hom [def-pur-sheaf-hom] and $\pi_n:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F$ the quotient maps. For $n\ge1$ the $\mathcal O_X$-linear map $\mathcal H\to\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)$, $\varphi\mapsto\pi_n\circ\varphi$, vanishes on $\mathcal I^n\mathcal H$ (as $\mathcal I^n$ annihilates $\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F$), and every local map $\mathcal G\to\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F$ vanishes on $\mathcal I^n\mathcal G$; taking global sections one gets maps $\varepsilon_n:\Gamma(X,\mathcal H/\mathcal I^n\mathcal H)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G/\mathcal I^n\mathcal G,\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)$, compatible with the maps induced by the surjections $\mathcal H/\mathcal I^{n+1}\mathcal H\to\mathcal H/\mathcal I^n\mathcal H$ and with reduction of maps modulo $\mathcal I^n$. Hence a compatible sequence $(s_n)_n\in\varprojlim_n\Gamma(X,\mathcal H/\mathcal I^n\mathcal H)$ gives a morphism $(\varepsilon_n(s_n))_n:\mathcal G^\wedge\to\mathcal F^\wedge$ of $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$. Then the resulting map $$\varprojlim_n\Gamma(X,\mathcal H/\mathcal I^n\mathcal H)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)}(\mathcal G^\wedge,\mathcal F^\wedge)$$ is bijective.

proof.text: Use finite-level internal-Hom quotient factorization, at equal powers, for annihilation and the precomposition isomorphism. Define each e_n as the cokernel.desc of postcomposition, followed by the inverse of that precomposition isomorphism. The cokernel identity and inverse identity prove its specified factorization. The inverse is determined by the isomorphism, and the cokernel descendant is unique; no arbitrary existence witness is chosen.

For every transition a→b, precompose the desired compatibility with the cokernel projection of H at a and postcompose with precomposition by the quotient projection of G at a, with target F at b. The latter is an isomorphism by finite-level factorization since b+1≤a+1, so both cancellations are legitimate. Commute pre- and postcomposition, apply the factorization of e at a and b, and use q_a followed by the transition equals q_b. This proves compatibility for all transitions.

Define Φ(s) as the natural transformation whose components are homObjSectionsEquiv applied to sectionsMap(e_n)(s_n), and wrap it using ObjectProperty.homMk. Applying global sections and the naturality of homObjSectionsEquiv to the previous compatibility, then using s transition compatibility, proves the naturality square. Its component formula is definitional.

For injectivity, apply unique compatible section lifting to the components of Φ(s). Both s and any s′ with Φ(s′)=Φ(s) satisfy its lifting equations, hence uniqueness equates them. For surjectivity, apply the same lifting theorem to the components of any natural transformation α; the component equalities and NatTrans.ext show Φ(s)=α.

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against Stacks 0882 (coherent.tex 6438): it agrees; the map, implicit in Stacks, is written out in the statement and kept. Proof in five steps following Stacks' affine-local proof: (1) the maps e_n as morphisms of sheaves, the reduction maps rho_n, Hom in Coh(X,I) as compatible families, well-definedness of Phi and compatibility with restriction to affine opens; (2) on an affine open U = Spec A (A Noetherian) the sections are H = Hom_A(N,M), H/I^nH, Hom_A(N/I^n, M/I^n) (Gamma fully faithful on quasi-coherent modules, quasi-coherence of the coherent sheaf Hom); (3) via the equivalence 087W the map becomes beta: H^ -> Hom_{A^}(N^, M^); (4) beta is bijective by Stacks' chain, 00MA(3) three times, 00MB(1) and 087R(1), checked to be beta on generators 1 (x) h; (5) gluing from affine opens to X. Stmt_deps kept. Two new nodes, both Mathlib leaves: lem-weil-pbc-completion-finite-module-tensor (00MA(3) with naturality: AdicCompletion.ofTensorProductEquivOfFiniteNoetherian) and lem-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-hom-finitely-presented (087R(1): Module.FinitePresentation.isBaseChange_map). Stacks' proof names the modules inconsistently (F, G given by M, N but H = Hom_A(M, N), i.e. Hom(F, G)); harmless, the node uses Hom(G, F) = Hom_A(N, M) throughout. Uses pqf-lem-affine-open-locnoeth (unit sk-prop-nagata-sketch-zmt) as a generic tool lemma.
